name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel with one knee on the floor near a wall and place the shin of that leg up the wall.
Step your other foot forward into a lunge position.
Raise your torso upright and squeeze your glute until you feel a stretch in the front of your thigh and hip.
image_prompt_scene: With one knee on the floor and the shin up a wall and the other foot forward.
